source: Preserved 241-preset design manifest from the SpinDoctor candidate, carried forward with the installed runtime. Historical observed/proposed labels do not override runtime availability.

conventions.qubitOrdering: q0 is the least-significant bit. Display computational kets as |q(n-1)...q0>. Basis index i stores amplitude for binary i in that display ordering.
conventions.angles: Current observed parser accepts numeric decimal radians. Symbolic pi expressions appear only in proposed extensions.
conventions.gateOrder: Apply listed commands in execution order. Do not reverse matrix composition or qubit operands.
conventions.phase: Preserve actual complex amplitudes, including global phase, during computation. Canonicalize only a display copy. Controlled operations can turn a previously global phase into a relative branch phase.
conventions.measurements: Observed q.circuit joint shots are separate from queries of its premeasurement state. Only q.tranche measurements explicitly containing collapse change the selected tranche. Ordinary independent-sampling preset commands default to 1024 shots; their editable native maximum remains 100000. A collapsing tranche measurement requires exactly one shot. A resource sampling estimate uses a declared hypothetical count and executes no measurement shots.
conventions.asynchronousExecution: A preset is a sequence, not a semicolon string sent blindly. Await the active gate/run job before dependent operations or queries; inspect errors and abort dependent steps after failure.
conventions.systems: The procedural address grid describes independent one-qubit states. Tranches and named circuits describe joint registers. Independent groups of 29 qubits do not jointly represent a 500-trillion-qubit entangled state.
conventions.memory: Current observed default memory cap is 512 MiB. A general dense 29-qubit complex128 statevector needs 8 GiB before overhead. Factor blocks can be smaller until entangling operations merge them.
conventions.backend: Observed syntax does not certify an installed or presently accessible implementation. Proposed commands remain disabled until their parser, numerical backend and validation exist.

proposedGrammar.options: Each proposed extension command uses family action followed by key=value arguments. Quote expressions containing spaces. Square brackets represent typed lists or matrices; parse their contents rather than executing them as host-language code. A quoted gates="...;..." or left="...;..." value is one safely parsed gate-sequence field; its semicolons are not terminal macro separators or shell separators.
proposedGrammar.complexNumbers: Accept numeric decimals, rational constants, i, sqrt(...), exp(i*theta), and pi through a restricted mathematical expression parser. Reject unsafe names, code evaluation and nonfinite values.
proposedGrammar.qMath: q.math accepts supplied vectors, matrices or gate names. Return exact algebra when independently verified; otherwise label numerical approximations and state tolerances.
proposedGrammar.qQuery: q.query reads the selected circuit's completed premeasurement state. Enforce output bounds. Pauli strings use explicit labels such as X0 X1. A requested qubit-list order must be shown in the output.
proposedGrammar.qNoise: q.noise accepts explicit states/circuits and channel conventions. Build physical density matrices using Kraus maps or equivalent verified formulas. No unitary-only backend may claim to produce mixed-state evolution.
proposedGrammar.qQec: q.qec performs ideal code demonstrations with explicit generators, error sets and recovery assumptions. Educational code models do not imply hardware fault tolerance.
proposedGrammar.qCompile: q.compile checks identities, classifications and metrics under specified conventions. Numerical synthesis requires a real algorithm and independent matrix-error verification.
proposedGrammar.qResource: q.resource performs explicit arithmetic under declared dtype, representation, cap and overhead assumptions. No estimates imply successful allocations or hardware capacity.
proposedGrammar.qModel: q.model requires explicit Hamiltonian and energy conventions. Universal model equivalence is separate from specific hardware claims.
proposedGrammar.qLesson: q.lesson returns explanations. Browse primary sources for current standards, device claims or contested claims; mark conjectures and assumptions.
proposedGrammar.qAlgorithm: q.algorithm expands a declared small algorithm into explicit gates and initial states before simulation; declare oracle, eigenstate, controlled-power mapping, swaps and bit order. Report ideal probabilities separately from samples.

menuDesign.preview: Show the full sequence, relevant backend and brief expected result before running.
menuDesign.execution: Clone or create a fresh named circuit for circuit presets; append a suffix on collision. Await jobs. Keep ideal probabilities separate from sample counts.
menuDesign.proposedCommands: Display a design preview with an implementation-needed badge; do not enqueue a command that is not installed.
menuDesign.exports: Support selected preset, all presets and plain-text command-reference downloads through the existing UI once implemented.
